title: Fix landing page static photo + music reliability in production

requirements.summary: Replace Google Photos share link with a local static portrait photo as the primary source and keep a graceful placeholder fallback on load failure.
acceptanceCriteria: When the app is deployed, the photo renders without requiring access to Google Photos share pages.
If the local photo asset is missing or cannot be loaded, the UI shows /assets/generated/photo-placeholder.dim_1024x1024.png without breaking layout.
The Google Photos URL is not the only/primary way the photo is displayed (it may be retained only as an optional backup if needed).

file_operations.description: Update the landing page photo to use the local static asset at /assets/generated/iman-photo.dim_1024x1024.jpg as the primary src, with onError-driven fallback to /assets/generated/photo-placeholder.dim_1024x1024.png. Remove reliance on the Google Photos share URL as the primary source and ensure the layout remains stable when switching to fallback.
Add the required square portrait photo asset to the public static directory so it is served in production at the absolute URL /assets/generated/iman-photo.dim_1024x1024.jpg.

requirements.summary: Ensure the landing page audio player reliably loads the local MP3 in production and shows a clear user-visible error message on load/decode/play failures while preserving the exact track label.
acceptanceCriteria: The audio player successfully plays the track in a deployed build (not only locally).
If /assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3 is missing or fails to load, the page shows an English error message near the player (and does not silently fail).
The track label text remains exactly: "20 dollears in my pocket".

file_operations.description: Add audio load/play error handling for the <audio> element that references /assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3: track an error state via audio error events and/or play() promise rejection, and render a clear English error message near the player (suggesting refresh or checking the asset path). Keep the track label text exactly "20 dollears in my pocket".

requirements.summary: Ensure required static media (portrait photo and MP3) are present under frontend public assets so deployed builds can fetch them via absolute URLs without backend changes.
acceptanceCriteria: A square portrait photo asset exists at a stable public path and is the one used by the landing page photo component.
The MP3 file is present at /assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3 in the deployed build output and returns a successful HTTP response when requested.
No backend changes are required for serving the photo/audio.

file_operations.description: Place the MP3 file into the public static assets directory so it is included in the frontend build output and served in production at the absolute URL /assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3.

Verify the landing page is wired to the public absolute URLs for static media: photo at /assets/generated/iman-photo.dim_1024x1024.jpg with placeholder fallback /assets/generated/photo-placeholder.dim_1024x1024.png, and audio source at /assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3, so deployed builds do not depend on non-public build paths.
